description: Source code implementing various linear algebra routines (e.g., Cholesky, LU, eigenvalue decompositions, QR, SVD) for CPU tensors in the PyTorch library, with dispatching and registration for different CPU architectures.

methods.name: apply_cholesky
methods.description: Performs in-place Cholesky decomposition on input tensor, using LAPACK if available.

methods.name: cholesky_kernel
methods.description: Dispatches to apply_cholesky for different data types.

methods.name: apply_reflect_conj_tri_single
methods.description: Copies and conjugates the triangle of a matrix in-place.

methods.name: apply_cholesky_inverse
methods.description: Computes in-place inverse of a positive-definite matrix using Cholesky factorization.

methods.name: cholesky_inverse_kernel_impl
methods.description: Dispatches in-place inverse computation for Cholesky.

methods.name: linalg_eig_make_complex_eigenvectors_cpu_impl
methods.description: Constructs complex eigenvectors from real-valued outputs from LAPACK.

methods.name: linalg_eig_make_complex_eigenvectors_cpu
methods.description: Dispatches to construct complex eigenvectors on CPU.

methods.name: lapack_work_to_int
methods.description: Converts LAPACK workspace size query result to integer, adding 1 ULP for accuracy.

methods.name: apply_linalg_eig
methods.description: Computes eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a matrix, in-place, using LAPACK.

methods.name: linalg_eig_kernel
methods.description: Dispatches eigenvalue decomposition for different data types.

methods.name: apply_lapack_eigh
methods.description: Computes eigenvalues and eigenvectors of Hermitian matrices using LAPACK.

methods.name: linalg_eigh_kernel
methods.description: Dispatches Hermitian eigendecomposition for different data types.

methods.name: apply_geqrf
methods.description: Performs QR decomposition (geqrf) in-place on input tensor.

methods.name: geqrf_kernel
methods.description: Dispatches QR decomposition for different data types.

methods.name: apply_orgqr
methods.description: Reconstructs the orthogonal/unitary matrix Q from elementary reflectors.

methods.name: orgqr_kernel_impl
methods.description: Dispatches to apply_orgqr for different data types.

methods.name: apply_lstsq
methods.description: Solves least squares problems using LAPACK routines.

methods.name: lstsq_kernel
methods.description: Dispatches least squares solver for different data types and drivers.

methods.name: apply_ormqr
methods.description: Multiplies Q with another matrix from QR factorization.

methods.name: ormqr_kernel
methods.description: Dispatches to apply_ormqr for different data types.

methods.name: apply_triangular_solve
methods.description: Solves triangular matrix equations in-place.

methods.name: triangular_solve_kernel
methods.description: Dispatches triangular solve for different data types.

methods.name: apply_ldl_factor
methods.description: Performs LDL factorization of a matrix.

methods.name: ldl_factor_kernel
methods.description: Dispatches LDL factorization for different data types.

methods.name: apply_ldl_solve
methods.description: Solves LDL systems in-place.

methods.name: ldl_solve_kernel
methods.description: Dispatches LDL solve for different data types.

methods.name: apply_lu_factor
methods.description: Performs LU factorization with pivoting.

methods.name: lu_factor_kernel
methods.description: Dispatches LU factorization for different data types.

methods.name: apply_lu_solve
methods.description: Solves LU systems in-place.

methods.name: lu_solve_kernel
methods.description: Dispatches LU solve for different data types.

methods.name: apply_svd
methods.description: Performs SVD decomposition in-place.

methods.name: svd_kernel
methods.description: Dispatches SVD for different data types.

methods.name: unpack_pivots_cpu_kernel
methods.description: Unpacks pivot indices for LU factorization.
